translations.title: Nizatidine 75 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used for excess stomach acid, heartburn and acid burping.
translations.usage: Adults aged 15–79 take one tablet (75 mg) once a day. If your symptoms have not improved after 8 hours, you may take one more tablet. Do not take more than two tablets (150 mg) in one day. Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have ever reacted to this medicine or to another H2 blocker; if you have a blood disorder, liver or kidney disease, a stomach or duodenal condition, or asthma or rheumatism; if you are under 15 or 80 or older; or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Talk to a pharmacist before taking it if you are prone to allergies or are 65 or older, if you have a sore throat, cough or high fever, unexplained weight loss, or ongoing stomach pain. While taking this medicine, do not take other stomach medicines, steroids, antibiotics, anticancer drugs, azole antifungals, high-dose aspirin, gefitinib, prulifloxacin or atazanavir.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Excess stomach acid, heartburn, acid burping
summaryTable.Who should be careful: Under 15 or 80 and over; liver or kidney disease
summaryTable.Why this one: An H2 blocker that reduces acid production
